name: Universidad CEU San Pablo
overview:
IMPORTANT - ADDITIONAL PROGRAM REQUIREMENTS


Students must demonstrate a B2 level in Spanish via an interview with a Spanish speaker prior to selecting this university in their choices (organized by IAFF team)


_____________________________________________________________________________________



Founded in 1933, CEU University is one of the oldest and most prestigious private Spanish universities, and is ranked 17th in the nation.


The main campus is located in Moncloa, in the center of Madrid, and includes administration buildings as well as several hubs for journalism, communications, art, etc.


The Monteprincipe campus, which is easily accessible by tram and free shuttles from Moncloa, brings together the centers for:

  • Health (dentistry, physiotherapy, pharmacy, medicine, nursing, etc.)
  • Architecture (polytechnic school)


CEU San Pablo is very open to the international community (it welcomes nearly 10,000 students) and provides access to employment for its graduates.



Finally, recent installations with state-of-the-art equipment, in particular state-of-the-art TV sets and professional radio studios, as well as individual attention given to each of the students, makes CEU San Pablo an ideal destination for studies in Spain.

administrative:
1) Application Dossier


Once the IAFF office has sent your nomination, the partner university will contact you directly by email to start your application.


All required documents will have to be uploaded on their platform or sent by email before the deadline (see EMEA Teams channel for each application deadline).


If you have not received anything yet, it means your nomination has not been sent yet — please be patient.


To be completed with your Epitech bachelor campus administration during the registration period for Tech4 (usually in April/May):

  • The addendum to the contract
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier


2) Visa


  • For European students, a valid passport or national ID card is sufficient to travel to Europe (exception: the UK).
  • For non-European students or those with non-European citizenship, please check the immigration office of the host country for visa process and fees.
  • Students in France can use this website:
  • https://www.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fr/


3) Insurance


For European students


The European Health Insurance Card (CEAM) is nominative and individual. This card certifies your rights to Health Insurance in Europe.


To obtain your card, log in to your Ameli account at least two months before your departure.


It is free of charge and will be sent to your home within two weeks. You can also download it online.


More information: https://www.ameli.fr/assure/droits-demarches/europe-international/protection-sociale-etranger/etudes-etranger


For non-European students


You must register for a private health insurance to cover your full stay.


Please check with your parents, bank, or any private insurance company depending on the desired coverage.


French citizens only:


Please register via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Ariane) platform to be aware of any news (terrorist attack, tsunami, earthquake, etc.): https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/public/login.html
